Janelle: Morning micro-poll — if your Monday had a theme song, drop a one-liner, not an album name. :sunglasses:
Ravi: 'Buffering... please wait.' :coffee:
Chris: 'Hit snooze, still losing.'
Morgan: 'I brought snacks so this is technically going well.' :croissant:
Ezra: '404 Motivation Not Found'
Lila: 'Turning caffeine into optimism.' :coffee:
Ben: 'Someone please narrate my calendar.' :joy:
Janelle: Love these. Quick follow-up: who cleaned the communal mug sink this morning? @Olivia? :eyes:
Olivia: Guilty. Left a post-it: 'Sanitized-ish' :sweat_smile:
kudos-bot: :tada: Olivia received a kudos from Morgan: 'Savior of mugs' — +1 point
Chris: Also PSA: the microwave hinge is loose. If you hear a dramatic creak, that's why. Please avoid slamming the door.
Ravi: Noted. Microwave now has a designated whisper policy.
Ben: Quick one-liner contest — winner gets my leftover banana bread tomorrow. Entries close at 15:00.
Janelle: 'I run on coffee and questionable life choices.'
Ezra: 'Professional overthinker, occasional doer.'
Lila: 'Email inbox: the ultimate thriller series.'
Morgan: 'My plant and I are both photosynthesizing regrets.'
Olivia: 'Gym tomorrow, maybe? Same as last week.'
Janelle: Voting with :thumbsup: for 'Email inbox: the ultimate thriller series.'
Ben: :raised_hands: That one wins — banana bread reserved. Thanks all, thread closed.
